people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
translations.bsb: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.
translations.kjv: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
translations.asv: When the report cometh to Egypt, they shall be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
